title: Federal Contract Recompete Radar input
description: Watch US federal contracts whose period of performance ends soon. Pass the same monitorId on every scheduled run (or run a saved Task): each run returns only contracts this watch has not delivered yet, or whose dates or amounts changed. Minimal call: {"naicsCodes": ["541512"], "minAwardAmount": 1000000, "monitorId": "it-services"}. Pricing: $0.01 per successful run and $0.005 per contract delivered (unchanged contracts, the summary and failed runs are free); set a maximum charge on the run to cap spending. An expiring contract is a lead, not a solicitation.

naicsCodes.title: NAICS codes
naicsCodes.description: Industry codes of the contracts to watch, 2 to 6 digits. 541512 = computer systems design; a shorter prefix such as 5415 covers every code starting with it.

pscCodes.title: PSC codes
pscCodes.description: Product and service codes, 1 to 4 characters (for example R425 = engineering support, DA01 = IT application development support).

agencies.title: Awarding agencies
agencies.description: Full official names of top-tier awarding agencies, for example 'Department of Homeland Security' or 'General Services Administration'. A name the source does not know matches nothing (the run report says so).

states.title: Place of performance (states)
states.description: Two-letter US state or territory codes where the work is performed, for example VA, MD, DC.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Up to 5 search terms matched by the source against the contract description and related text (3 to 60 characters each).

minAwardAmount.title: Minimum award amount (USD)
minAwardAmount.description: Only contracts with at least this amount obligated so far. Leave empty for every size.

expiringWithinDays.title: Ending within (days)
expiringWithinDays.description: Far edge of the window: contracts whose current period of performance ends within this many days from today.

expiringFromDays.title: Ending no sooner than (days)
expiringFromDays.description: Near edge of the window. 0 = from today. Set 90 with 'Ending within' 365 to watch contracts ending in 3 to 12 months.

activeWithinMonths.title: Reported activity within (months)
activeWithinMonths.description: Only contracts with an action reported to the source in this period. Longer finds older multi-year contracts and makes the search broader.

includeDetails.title: Include award details
includeDetails.description: Adds, per delivered contract: potential end date with all options, whether the end is an option period or the final period, obligations, ceiling, competition, set-aside, parent vehicle. One extra request per delivered contract.

includeModifications.title: Include recent modifications
includeModifications.description: Adds the latest modifications of each delivered contract (option exercised, funding action, extension ...). One more request per delivered contract.

maxModifications.title: Modifications per contract
maxModifications.description: How many of the latest modifications to include.

trackLeftWindow.title: Report contracts that leave the window
trackLeftWindow.description: When a contract you received no longer ends in the window, look at its record: if its end date moved (extended or shortened) you get one 'left_window' record with the old and new dates.

maxContractsPerRun.title: Maximum contracts per run
maxContractsPerRun.description: Upper limit of delivered (billed) contracts in one run, soonest ending first. The rest follow in the next run. The form starts at 25 so a first try costs at most $0.135; the default without a value is 200.

firstRun.title: First run
enumTitles: Deliver every contract in the window
Record silently, deliver only what changes afterwards
firstRun.description: What the first run of a watch does with the contracts already in the window.

monitorId.title: Watch name (monitorId)
monitorId.description: Name of this watch, 1 to 40 letters, digits, '-' or '_'. Runs with the same name share one memory. Not needed when you run a saved Task: each Task has its own memory.

stateStoreName.title: Memory store name (advanced)
stateStoreName.description: Explicit name of the key-value store that holds the watch memory. Leave empty unless you manage stores yourself.

emitSummary.title: Add a run summary record
emitSummary.description: One free record per run with the window, counts, the date of the latest source data load and the freshness note.

requestTimeoutSecs.title: Request timeout (seconds)
requestTimeoutSecs.description: Time allowed for one request to the source.

maxRetries.title: Retries per request
maxRetries.description: Retries after a timeout or a temporary error of the source.
